core_pages_and_views.name: Customer Detailing & Home Service Booking Portal
key_sections: Navigation bar with logo, links (Home, Kalkulator, Katalog, Lacak, Admin Panel), and direct CTA 'Booking Sekarang'

Hero Section: High contrast tactical badge ('Workshop Detailing & Home Service'), headline 'Kembalikan Kilau Sempurna Motor, Mobil & Helm Anda', dual CTA ('Booking Workshop / Home Service' & 'Kalkulator Harga Instan'), key stats (1,250+ Unit, 4.9 Rating, 100% Garansi)

Interactive Price Calculator (Kalkulator Harga Instan): Category selector (Motorcycle, Car, Helmet Spa), vehicle size/type, service location (Workshop Garasi vs Home Service Panggilan), multi-select service packages (Paint Correction, Engine Deep Degreaser, Ceramic Coating 9H+, Wet Gloss Finish), real-time live total calculator

Booking Form & Workflow Modal/Section: Date, time slot, vehicle details (brand, model, plate number), location/address for home service, customer contacts (WhatsApp & Name), payment method preference, live submission with instant code generation (e.g. HG-2026-DEMO01)
Live Status Tracking (Lacak Booking): Search by Booking ID or WhatsApp number with visual step status indicator (Diterima -> Penjadwalan -> Dalam Pengerjaan -> QC Steril -> Selesai / Siap Ambil)
Pre-Owned Unit Catalog (Katalog Unit Motors & Helm): Filterable grid with specs, condition rating, price tag, and 'Tanya via WA / Booking Unit' button
Before & After Interactive Slider (Galeri Transformasi): Interactive compare slider showing paint restoration results
Workshop Facility & Contact Map Section: Operating hours, address (Jl. Raya Otomotif Bintaro), Google Maps link, facility features (CCTV 24/7, Free Wi-Fi, AC Lounge)

core_pages_and_views.name: Garage Operations & Booking Management Dashboard
key_sections: Admin Bar & Operational KPI Cards: Total Bookings, Active In-Bay Work, Home Service Dispatched, Monthly Revenue
Interactive Booking Calendar & Queue List: Filter by Status (Pending, Confirmed, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled) & Service Type (Workshop vs Home Service)
Vehicle & Customer Inspection Records: Detail drawer showing vehicle condition checklist, assigned mechanic, ceramic coating warranty status, and status progress controller
New Booking & Quick Status Update Modal: Fast operational status toggle with automated simulated WhatsApp notification trigger

interactive_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for confirmation messages (e.g., 'Booking berhasil dibuat dengan kode HG-2026-X89')
interactive_guidelines.micro_interactions: Buttons must have active scale feedback (`active:scale-[0.98]`), red accent highlight on active tabs, and clear visible hover contrast
interactive_guidelines.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, input fields, selects, tabs, status tags, and cards MUST have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='booking-submit-btn', data-testid='calc-vehicle-type-select')

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the user requested color combination: Gray, Black, White, and Red (#DC2626 accents). Avoid purple, generic blue, or teal tones.
Implement both the Customer Facing Booking & Tracking Experience and the Operations Admin Dashboard view switcher seamlessly so users can test both customer booking and garage management.
Ensure the Instant Price Calculator computes total cost live as vehicle type, service location (Workshop vs Home Service), and multiple service options are selected.
Save created bookings in local state / persistent state so created bookings immediately appear in the Lacak Booking status search and the Admin Operations Dashboard list.
Make sure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, filters) include data-testid attributes for automated testing.
